component.name: Musicat
component.summary: Offline music player and tag editor for a local library

description.p: This is a community package of Musicat, maintained independently. It repackages the official upstream build unmodified.
Musicat is a player for the music you keep on disk. It links your library in place instead of importing copies of it, and doubles as a tag editor for the files it plays.

ul.li: Plays MP3, FLAC, WAV, AAC and OGG, with gapless playback for tracks that share a sample rate.
Reads and writes ID3v2 and Vorbis tags, including album art.
Watches your folders and re-scans them as the library changes.
Builds smart playlists from queries over your own metadata.
Fetches album art, artist information and lyrics from the web.
Shows the library as a world map, a timeline, statistics and a waveform view.

description.p: By default this package can read and write your Music directory, and Musicat keeps its library index, settings and caches in its private per-app directory, which Flatpak redirects into ~/.var/app/io.github.basharovV.musicat.

If your music lives somewhere else, grant only that location: flatpak override --user --filesystem=/path/to/music io.github.basharovV.musicat. To expose your whole home directory instead, opt in with flatpak override --user --filesystem=home io.github.basharovV.musicat. Remove custom grants with flatpak override --user --reset io.github.basharovV.musicat.
Musicat needs network access to look up album art, artist information and lyrics. Install application updates through Flatpak.
